arguments.message: Hi there! If the invoice you received by email doesn’t match anything in your account’s billing history, it’s a good idea to treat it as unverified. Every genuine Meridian invoice is also listed in your workspace under **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. Compare the amount, due date, and invoice number in the email with what you see there. If you can’t find a matching entry, don’t pay the invoice until you’ve confirmed it’s legitimate—either by checking with the billing contact listed in your workspace or by reaching out to our support team for further verification.
